name: Rainforest Trust Feasibility Awards
summary: Small awards to registered NGOs to close specific information gaps, such as a legal pathway or species surveys, before applying to create or expand a protected or conserved area. The page gives an average size of about USD 10,000.

status.quote: Concept notes are accepted anytime, and reviewed within 1-2 months.

applicant_types.quote: All applicants must be legally registered, non-government organizations that are authorized to conduct work in the country of the proposed project.

geography.quote: Our primary focus is the tropics and subtropics but strong proposals from outside these areas that meet all other criteria will be considered.

access.quote: We only review applications submitted directly by eligible organizations, and we will work with you to refine your proposal if it aligns with our mission and priorities.

window.quote: Protected or Conserved Area Creation Feasibility Awards; Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of less than $250,000: These are accepted on a rolling basis and may be funded anytime throughout the year.
